card.name: Start of a new term in drug text
card.fires_on: Short words like "to" before a purpose verb, and the first letter B or P of a new term such as B. anthracis, bivalirudin, bicalutamide or P450, in research and drug-interaction text.

modes.label: Purpose "to"
modes.description: The word to or a verb right after it, introducing an aim of research.
modes.example: The article suggests how this information may be used<< to>> develop novel peptides with a desired activity.

modes.label: Initial B of a name
modes.description: A lone capital or lowercase b that begins an organism or drug name.
modes.example: NIAID is also seeking new drugs that attack<< B>>. anthracis at different levels.

modes.label: Initial P in CYP P450
modes.description: The letter P split off at the start of P450 after CYP.

card.writes: Promotes words like rational and screen, suggesting a lean toward rational drug design and screening language.
card.plain: It fires on the first letter of a drug or germ name, or on "to" before a research aim.
